start_tracing_playwright: start tracing in playwright with snapshots, screenshots, and source inclusion enabled
create_tracing_chunk: create a named tracing chunk with a title for grouping trace events
stop_tracing_save_file: stop tracing and save the trace archive to a local file path
group_trace_events: group trace events under a named category with an optional location
end_tracing_group: end the currently active tracing group and return to the parent scope
